data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable data storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; the byte ceiling prevents unbounded growth without permitting automatic deletion.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: meta-optimization-manager
service.description: Measures local-coding-agent readiness by aggregating Answer/Validate/Guide coverage across the fleet and surfacing where to focus.

search-hub.description: Owns the Answer projection denominator (`search-hub space --projection answer`) and the live numerator (`providers list`). MoM does not self-register a provider here — readiness is discoverable via cli-health command federation (see docs/internal/DECISIONS.md, 2026-06-24).
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Answer-projection coverage is reported unavailable (available=false) with an honest reason; the other projections still compute.

test-genie.description: Owns the Validate projection denominator (`test-genie space --projection validate`) and the live numerator (`health` / `fleet status`).
test-genie.degraded_behavior: Validate-projection coverage is reported unavailable; the other projections still compute.

prompt-manager.description: Owns the Guide projection denominator (`prompt-manager space --projection guide`) and the live numerator (`graph health`). Also the trials task suite source.
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Guide-projection coverage is reported unavailable; the other projections still compute.

program-runtime.description: Owns the Act projection numerator and typed program/friction condition data consumed by focus.
program-runtime.degraded_behavior: Act coverage and program-runtime focus signals are reported unavailable with an honest reason; other projections still compute.

scenario-completeness-scoring.description: Per-scenario completeness numerator (GetScore) joined into the Answer maturity cell.
scenario-completeness-scoring.degraded_behavior: Completeness-derived cells degrade to declared-unverified; coverage still computes.

code-facts.description: Structural facts (imports, replicas, surfaces) read by the convergence template-fitness lenses.
code-facts.degraded_behavior: Convergence template-fitness reports the affected lenses as unavailable.

architecture-cartographer.description: Structural cohesion / drift signals read by the convergence lenses.
architecture-cartographer.degraded_behavior: Convergence drift-surface lens reports unavailable; other lenses still compute.

scenario-auditor.description: Clean-on-all-tools reference-scenario health read by the convergence reference-eligibility check.
scenario-auditor.degraded_behavior: Reference eligibility falls back to template-staleness only.

agent-manager.description: The sandboxed-agent spawner for the empirical trials gate. MoM reconciles its declared role-only trials profile, then creates a task and sandboxed run, polls it, and collects the diff. Agent Manager owns runtime and resource selection; MoM never talks to a sandbox directly. Explicit-invocation only.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Each `trials run` degrades to a recorded VerdictError with a clear reason; recorded history still serves and the suite never blocks.
